name: Popo Mathual
source: A magician from the "Tabit" race, who looks like a rabbit. Members of his race tend to have higher intelligence than that of humans, thus his pride in himself is strangely high. He calls himself  "Rare Genius Mage" (稀代の天才魔導師).
